newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - HSBC/Capel sees higher Danish 1997 GDP.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - HSBC/Capel sees higher Danish 1997 GDP.

text.p: In its latest survey HSBC/James Capel investment bank on Thursday raised its expectations for Denmark's 1997 GDP (gross domestic product) growth to 2.8 percent from 2.5 percent in its last forecast in June last year.
At the same time it upped its forecast for the 1997 current account to a one billion crown surplus from a one billion crown deficit, leaving its estimate for inflation unchanged at 2.5 percent.

The latest Danish Economy Ministry forecast in December foresaw 2.9 percent GDP growth, 2.3 percent inflation, 8.0 percent unemployment and a current account surplus of 13.0 billion crowns for this year.
The following estimates were made by 10 leading local and international organisations.
